note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on PlayStation Network on 18 November 2026 and reported by Exophase, PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements (see the Sources section in the app). Guides are written in the author's own words. GTA VI has no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (PSN, 18 November 2026)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide (difficulty, time and missable reporting)
GTABase — GTA VI trophy and achievement list
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

trophies.guide: The Platinum is the reward for everything else. There is no shortcut: earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then the long grinds (100% completion, 250 stunts, all gold shooting-range medals) — and treat the Platinum as the finish line, not a trophy to chase directly.
trophies.missableWhy: Unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first mission of the game and introduces the fishing mechanic, so follow the on-screen prompts, take your time with the catch, and the trophy pops when the mission completes. Nothing here can be missed.
trophies.missableWhy: Story mission; it unlocks by playing through the opening.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, check the one reported missable in the whole list — the balcony meditation that counts toward Positive Mental Attitude — and make a manual save at the start of the chapter, because the game has no mission replay. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.missableWhy: Story chapter; it unlocks by finishing the chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. This is where both protagonists become playable, so most of the open-world list opens up here — use the downtime between story missions to try activities, discover vehicles and start the collectible hunts. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter. The trophy pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.missableWhy: Story chapter; it unlocks by finishing the chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep a manual save from the chapter's start in case you want to revisit anything later, since there is no mission replay. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission completes.
trophies.missableWhy: Story chapter; it unlocks by finishing the chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. By now you should be deep into the side content too, but the chapter trophy only needs the story missions. Save manually at the chapter's start, play through to the final mission, and the trophy pops when it ends.
trophies.missableWhy: Story chapter; it unlocks by finishing the chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Before you start it, make a manual save — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save from before the finale is your only way back to mop up anything left. The trophy is Gold and pops when the credits roll, so finish the story first and clean up afterwards.
trophies.missableWhy: Story mission; it unlocks by finishing the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. It is a story mission, so just play through it — follow the objective markers, drive carefully on the timed sections, and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.missableWhy: Story mission; it unlocks by playing the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. Stock up on armour and ammo before you start, use cover during the shootout sections, and remember your escape route — heists punish rushing. The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.missableWhy: Story mission; it unlocks by playing the story.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. Play it as the story presents it and follow the objectives; there is no special requirement beyond finishing the mission, so the trophy pops at its end.
trophies.missableWhy: Story mission; it unlocks by playing the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. Keep your health and armour topped up before the mission starts, use Combat Focus in the heavy firefights, and the trophy pops when the mission wraps up.
trophies.missableWhy: Story mission; it unlocks by playing the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. This one takes place around the airport, so expect open ground and long sightlines — use a scoped weapon where you can and keep moving between cover. The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.missableWhy: Story mission; it unlocks by playing the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Bring your best weapons and full armour, take the fight methodically rather than charging in, and the trophy pops when the operation is over.
trophies.missableWhy: Story mission; it unlocks by playing the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. This is the hardest trophy in the list and the reason the Platinum takes around 200 hours: it means finishing the story, all stranger strands, the collectibles, the activities and the exploration goals. Work through this guide's roadmap in order, tick off each category as you go, and use the in-game stats screen to find what is left. Do the Chapter 1 meditation spot early — it is the one reported missable piece of the whole checklist.
trophies.missableWhy: 100% completion is always available after the story; nothing in the checklist is missable except the meditation spot in Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. A stunt is any trick jump, long airtime, near miss, wheelie or drift the game counts — the counter ticks up in free roam, so you do not need a special event. The fastest way is to find a ramp or jump with a fast bike, repeat the same jump, and let the counter climb. Track your total in the stats screen and chip away at it between other goals.
trophies.missableWhy: Stunts can be performed anywhere, any time, in free roam.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types at least once: racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, meditation, hunting, bowling and the other open-world pastimes the game offers. You do not need to win or finish any of them — just start each one once. Open the activities section of the map and tick them off one by one; the trophy pops when the last type is tried.
trophies.missableWhy: Activities stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the range, pick a weapon class, and learn each challenge's target pattern before going for gold — steady aim beats speed, and a controller with a low sensitivity helps. Work through one weapon class at a time and replay any challenge that lands silver until it turns gold. The trophy pops when the last challenge hits gold.
trophies.missableWhy: The Shooting Range stays open in free roam; challenges can be retried without limit.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Find each race on the map, learn the course on a practice run, then race to win — cut corners through the rings where the course allows and keep the drone low to hold speed. The trophy pops after your win at the fourteenth location.
trophies.missableWhy: Drone races stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, so mix street races, off-road and boat races and use the best vehicle you own for each surface. The game counts each distinct race once, so winning the same race twice does not help — keep moving to new race markers on the map until you have 20 wins.
trophies.missableWhy: Races stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, accept the challenge, and fish carefully — keep the line tension in the safe zone, reel in steadily when the fish runs, and do not rush the catch. Winning the challenge pops the trophy.
trophies.missableWhy: Fishing challenges with Cal can be retried.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet, and play it through to the end — the games are short, so try the easiest cabinet first. The trophy pops when the game completes, win or lose, as long as you finish it.
trophies.missableWhy: Arcades stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand to its end. Andy's missions appear as you progress, so keep checking the map for his marker between story missions and play each one as it appears. The trophy pops when his final mission completes.
trophies.missableWhy: Side-character strands stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand to its end. Play each of Kenton's missions as they appear on the map and follow the strand through to its final job. The trophy pops when that last mission completes.
trophies.missableWhy: Side-character strands stay available after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand to its end. Billy's jobs appear across the map as the story progresses — take each one when it shows up and the strand ends with a final mission that pops the trophy.
trophies.missableWhy: Side-character strands stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question-mark markers on the map — talk to each one, play through their short mission chains, and move on to the next. There are more than eight strands in the game, so pick the ones nearest you and keep going until the eighth completes.
trophies.missableWhy: Stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand to its end. Play Randy's missions as they appear and follow the strand to its final job; the trophy pops when that mission completes.
trophies.missableWhy: Side-character strands stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand to its end. Take Tyrone's missions as they appear on the map, work through the strand, and the trophy pops when his final mission completes.
trophies.missableWhy: Side-character strands stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the ONE trophy reported as potentially missable: one meditation spot is on Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1 and disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay. Do that balcony spot during Chapter 1, before you finish the chapter. For the rest, visit each marked meditation spot, sit down and complete the session — the trophy pops at the eighteenth spot.
trophies.missableWhy: One meditation spot (Lucia's balcony) is only available in Chapter 1 and is gone afterwards; there is no mission replay. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Talk to Bret to get the hunt, follow the tracking clues to the animal's territory, and take the shot cleanly — a scoped rifle and patience beat a chase. The trophy pops when the hunt is complete.
trophies.missableWhy: Bret's hunt stays available in free roam.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, on tables and in hidden spots — so pick up every card you see and check your collection to find which sets are closest to complete. Focus on three sets first rather than spreading across all of them; the trophy pops when the third set is finished.
trophies.missableWhy: Cards stay collectible in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 locations. WAiNK marks are spread all over Leonida, so this is a long grind best done while travelling for other goals — stop and WAiNK at every new place you pass. Check your count in the stats screen and sweep the remaining areas at the end; the trophy pops at the hundredth location.
trophies.missableWhy: WAiNK locations stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the small tasks the game tracks — stunts, kills, driving feats and more — and they complete naturally as you play. Open the challenges menu to see which ones are close, finish the easy ones first, and the trophy pops at the fiftieth.
trophies.missableWhy: Challenges can be completed any time in free roam.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a four-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Cause chaos in a busy area until the fourth star appears, then break line of sight, get into a fast car and stay out of the search cones until the wanted level clears. The trophy pops when you escape clean.
trophies.missableWhy: Wanted levels can be raised any time in free roam with your partner.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together, plan a fast car parked outside each one, and move quickly — rob, get out, drive to the next. Keep the wanted level alive between robberies; the trophy pops after the third shop.
trophies.missableWhy: Shop robberies can be attempted any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Simply getting into a new vehicle type counts, so drive everything you see — cars, bikes, boats, planes and anything unusual. Park-hopping through traffic and visiting car parks, docks and airfields fills the list fast; the trophy pops at the hundredth discovery.
trophies.missableWhy: Vehicles stay discoverable in free roam.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with a group of enemies — a gang hideout or a police response works — trigger Combat Focus, and chain your shots while it lasts. Use a high-damage weapon and aim for quick kills; the trophy pops when the fifth enemy drops inside the same focus window.
trophies.missableWhy: Combat Focus can be used in any fight, any time.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Head to VCIA, get hold of a plane, and take off without following the normal departure routine — the trophy is about leaving the airport on your own terms. Any flyable aircraft at the airport works; the trophy pops once you are airborne and clear.
trophies.missableWhy: VCIA stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and stir up trouble. Find a Rhino — they appear at military areas and at high wanted levels — climb in, and enjoy the chaos until the trophy pops. Expect the full attention of the police, so make sure you are ready for a fight.
trophies.missableWhy: Rhinos can be found in free roam at high wanted levels and military sites.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewellery store without being detected. Go in quiet: case the store first, move when the staff are not looking, avoid cameras and guards, and get out before the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — the trophy only counts a clean, undetected robbery.
trophies.missableWhy: Jewellery stores can be robbed again in free roam.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Banks are the biggest robbery targets in the game, so plan each one: a fast getaway car, an escape route, and enough firepower to hold off the response. Rob one vault, escape clean, then move on to the next — the trophy pops after the fifth successful escape.
trophies.missableWhy: Bank vaults can be robbed in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape. Armoured trucks drive set routes around the state — wait for one on a quiet stretch of road, block it or force it to stop, take the cash, then lose the police. A fast car parked nearby makes the escape easy; the trophy pops once you are clear.
trophies.missableWhy: Armoured trucks run their routes in free roam.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail across the whole map — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the countryside — until the map is fully revealed. The trophy pops when the last area is discovered, so finish it by sweeping the edges of the map and any islands you have not visited.
trophies.missableWhy: The whole map stays open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Each gang runs its own operations around Leonida — find them, hit one per gang, and escape. The trophy pops once every gang's operation has been robbed.
trophies.missableWhy: Gang operations stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a sea view, order a cocktail and take in the sunset — the trophy pops once you are settled with your drink and the view. It is a relaxing one; do it between the louder goals.
trophies.missableWhy: Ocean Beach bars stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a showroom, pick a car, and crash straight out through the front window — the bigger the entrance, the better. The trophy pops as you burst through the glass.
trophies.missableWhy: Showrooms stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley, rent a lane and bowl a full game — the trophy is about the follow-through, so play the game properly and finish it. The trophy pops when the game ends.
trophies.missableWhy: The bowling alley stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal. This trophy is about your duo's reputation — play the partner missions, keep both characters' standing high, and complete the activities that grow your joint following. The trophy pops when your partnership reaches the level the game asks for.
trophies.missableWhy: Partnership progress can be built any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Reach the point in the story where a major choice is made. This trophy is tied to a story decision, so play through the story and it will pop when the choice is locked in. Keep a manual save from before the choice so you can see the other outcome if you want to.
trophies.missableWhy: Story trophy; it unlocks by playing the story.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Reach the story moment this trophy is named for — the second attempt at something that went wrong the first time. It is a story trophy, so just keep playing the story; it pops when the moment arrives. A manual save before the mission lets you replay it if you are curious.
trophies.missableWhy: Story trophy; it unlocks by playing the story.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Reach the story moment that earns this trophy — a surprise twist in the campaign. It is a story trophy and it pops on its own as you play through the mission it belongs to. No special action is needed beyond finishing that mission.
trophies.missableWhy: Story trophy; it unlocks by playing the story.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by. Get a vehicle, pick up speed, and swing a melee weapon from the window as you pass a group of enemies. Line up a straight run through a crowded spot and the trophy pops when the hit connects.
trophies.missableWhy: Melee drive-bys can be attempted any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to wash them into clean cash. Keep laundering after every big score and the total climbs; the trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.
trophies.missableWhy: Laundering stays available through contacts in free roam.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, cars, food and anything else the shops sell — every dollar counts toward the total. The big purchases help most, so save this for when you are buying vehicles and property; the trophy pops when your total spending crosses $100,000.
trophies.missableWhy: Shops stay open in free roam; spending is never locked out.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game. Garages are marked on the map and sold through the property menu — visit each one, pay the price, and move on. They are also useful for storing the vehicles you register, so buy them as you find them; the trophy pops when the last garage is yours.
trophies.missableWhy: Garage properties stay for sale in free roam.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle you like, open the Scooter Bros app and register it — then find nine more. Any vehicle type counts, so register the cars and bikes you already drive; the trophy pops at the tenth registration.
trophies.missableWhy: Vehicles can be registered any time in free roam.
trophies.name: On the Spot
